name: Stylized 3D Cartoon
visual_style: High-quality original stylized 3D animated film, appealing rounded designs, expressive characters and cohesive colorful art direction.
camera: Fluid animated-film camera with clear staging and readable silhouettes.
lighting: Soft global illumination, warm bounce light and playful color accents.
motion: Expressive animation with anticipation, squash-and-stretch, follow-through and stable character proportions.
consistency: Same character designs, proportions and colorful art direction in every scene.
negative_guidance: Off-model characters, uncanny realism, muddy colors, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Chunky rounded display type with playful weights
video.palette: Saturated, cheerful palette with warm highlights
video.transitions: Bouncy wipes, iris and pop transitions
video.pacing: Lively and upbeat with comic timing
video.sound: Pops, boings, sparkles and cartoon whooshes
